projectDescription: A Java EE 7 benchmark sample application modeled as an online stock trading system, used to measure and compare performance of Java EE application servers.
keyFeatures: End-to-end Java EE 7 benchmark application simulating a real-world stock trading workload
Multiple runtime modes: Full EJB3 and Direct JDBC
Asynchronous order processing via JMS message-driven beans (queue and pub/sub)
WebSocket support for real-time market summary updates
Dual web interface: JSP/Servlet and JSF (JavaServer Faces)
CDI, Bean Validation, JPA, JSONP, and Concurrency Utilities coverage
Apache JMeter integration for automated load testing
Deployable on Open Liberty with embedded Derby or external DB2
Container-ready with Docker and Kubernetes (OpenLiberty Operator) support
Web Primitives suite for testing individual Java EE components
publicApiSurface: TradeServices.register(String userID, String password, String fullname, String address, String email, String creditcard, BigDecimal openBalance)
TradeServices.buy(String userID, String symbol, double quantity, int orderProcessingMode)
TradeServices.sell(String userID, Integer holdingID, int orderProcessingMode)
